source_limitations: Oxford University Press official Oxford 3000 by CEFR level PDF opened directly via web text on 2026-10-29. PDF pages one-based; extracted lines zero-based in the web extraction. Oxford list supports word/POS CEFR only, NOT exact-sense CEFR, English or Myanmar translation quality, example correctness, British voice audio, or independent human approval. Homographs and mixed-sense entries require direct dictionary sense review. No shortlist changes, no audio, no deployment.
editorial_priority: have: family-relationship example differs from literal ownership gloss
like: Oxford distinguishes preposition similarity from verb enjoyment
all: A1 determiner/pronoun and separate A2 adverb
read: identical spelling but different past/present pronunciation
a/an: indefinite articles selected by sound, not letter
